lessons.title: Accepting, Refusing & Personal Traits
lessons.description: Making invitations, excuses, and friendship vocabulary

questions.rule:
1. Inviting: "Would you like to...?", "How about...?", "Shall we...?"
2. Accepting: "Sure, that sounds fun!", "Yeah, why not?", "I'd love to."
3. Refusing: "I'd love to, but I can't.", "Sorry, I am busy."
4. Key Adjectives: Honest (dürüst), Reliable (güvenilir), Stubborn (inatçı), Generous (cömert), Back up (desteklemek/arka çıkmak), Count on (güvenmek).
questions.examTip: LGS sorusunda daveti reddeden kişinin bir "özür / mazeret" (making an excuse) sunup sunmadığına dikkat edin!

questions.prompt:
Tom: "We are organizing a picnic on Sunday. Would you like to join us?"
Jack: "I'd love to, but I have to study for my exam."
What is Jack doing?
options: Refusing the invitation and making an excuse
questions.explanation: "I'd love to, but..." diyerek reddetmiş ve ders çalışması gerektiğini belirterek mazeret bildirmiştir.

questions.prompt: A true friend always _____ you when you need help and never tells your secrets to others.
questions.explanation: "Back up" desteklemek, arka çıkmak anlamına gelir. Gerçek dost daima destek olur.

questions.prompt: "Count on" and "trust" have similar meanings in English.
questions.explanation: Both "count on" and "rely on / trust" mean güvenmek.

questions.prompt: A person who never changes his mind is _____.
questions.explanation: "Stubborn" inatçı demektir; fikrini asla değiştirmeyen kişi.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT an accepting sentence?
questions.explanation: "I am full, thanks anyway" (Tokum, yine de sağ ol) kibar bir ret cümlesidir.

questions.prompt: Match the personality traits with their definitions:

matchingPairs.right: Always tells the truth, never lies
You can count on him/her, keeps secrets
Always helps and backs you up

questions.prompt: "Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?" What does this sentence express?
questions.explanation: "Why don't we...?" teklifte ve öneride bulunma yapısıdır.

lessons.title: Friendship Trophy Exam 🏆
lessons.description: LGS Style New Generation Friendship Reading & Dialogue Test

questions.rule:
- Read the question prompt first (According to the text, which of the following is CORRECT / NOT correct?)
- Check the table / chat message / ticket details carefully.
questions.examTip: Watch out for "buddy, best friend, mate, get on well with" synonyms in LGS!

questions.prompt:
Mark: "Are you doing anything on Saturday afternoon?"
Leo: "No, not at all. Why are you asking?"
What does Leo mean?
options: He has no plans and is available
He is very busy and has an exam
questions.explanation: "No, not at all" (Hayır, hiçbir işim yok) diyerek müsait olduğunu belirtmektedir.

questions.prompt: Sarah and Kate have a lot of things in common and they never argue. They are _____.
options: great buddies who get on well with each other
strangers who don't know each other
questions.explanation: "Get on well with each other" iyi geçinmek demektir.

questions.prompt: "I'm sorry, but I can't make it." is a way of refusing an invitation.
questions.explanation: "Gelemiyorum / başaramam" anlamına gelen yaygın bir ret ifadesidir.

questions.prompt: Best friends always _____ each other's secrets.
Which of the following describes a BAD friend?
options: He is arrogant and thinks he is better than everyone
questions.explanation: "Arrogant" kibirli demektir ve olumsuz bir özelliktir.

questions.prompt: Match the phrases with their categories:
What does "have things in common" mean?
questions.explanation: "Have things in common" ortak zevkleri ve ilgi alanları olmak demektir.
